_about.method: Read-only audit of source code first, documents second. Code wins where they disagree.

roots.W: C:\OpenFrame (Windows app and shared Rust core, main at 1711450)

_about.confidence_scale: high = read in code or a pinned file; medium = current document consistent with code; low = document only, or documents disagree

tagline.closest_official_text: Local-first studio for writers, screenwriters and production teams: ideas, story, screenplay and production planning.
tagline.note: No tagline is decided anywhere. The closest text is the installer short description. Audience wording 'writers, screenwriters and production teams' was decided by the owner on 2026-10-16.

audience.value: Writers, screenwriters and production teams; one app for everyone, no editions

windows.note: Store manifest MinVersion is 10.0.22000.0. The internal NSIS .exe does not itself check the Windows version. The AI runtime is pinned for Windows x64 only (CPU and Vulkan builds).

mac.value: Apple silicon Macs only (arm64), macOS 14.0 or later
mac.note: Intel Macs are not a release target. macOS 14 comes from the Swift package and the app bundle Info.plist, not from a product document.

architecture.value: One Rust core over SQLite; Windows shell in Tauri v2 with React and TypeScript; Mac shell in native SwiftUI through UniFFI

internal_windows.value: Unsigned NSIS .exe, per-user install, about 27 MB (OpenFrame-3.exe, 27,141,213 bytes, built 2026-10-20)
internal_windows.note: Tauri config also lists an MSI target, but only the .exe is used for the team. Next build would be OpenFrame-4.exe, only on the owner's word.

internal_mac.value: Unsigned, not notarized .dmg, planned for Mac phase M9
internal_mac.note: Not built. release-out/openframe-dmg.zip is a source handoff package for the Mac machine, not a disk image.

store_builds.value: Microsoft Store MSIX and Mac App Store .pkg, Chapter 3, not started

releaseStatus.value: Internal testing only. Windows track closed at phase W9; W10 (team hand test of OpenFrame-3.exe) is next. Mac app built on a separate branch, not merged, no .dmg. No public download, no signed build, no store listing, no website yet.

appVersion.note: Same in Cargo workspace, Tauri config and package.json. Installers are numbered by build (OpenFrame-1 to OpenFrame-3), not by version. Mac CFBundleVersion is version plus commit.

systemRequirements.os: Windows 11 x64, or macOS 14+ on Apple silicon

ram.known: No app-wide minimum is documented. The AI chat model needs 4 GB RAM minimum and 8 GB recommended. The team test plan wants one tester on an 8 GB laptop. A larger AI tier for 16 GB machines is decided but not built.

disk.known: Installer about 27 MB; optional AI download 1,238,430,528 bytes (shown as 1.2 GB) plus free space the app checks before downloading. No installed-size figure is documented.

cpu.known: No CPU minimum documented. Windows x64 only. GPU use (Vulkan on Windows, Metal on Mac) only when a first-run probe passes; speed measured only on Intel Arc integrated graphics.

optional.note: Before the download, and after removal, the app works fully; AI features show 'not installed'.

downloadSize.value: 1,238,430,528 bytes, displayed in the app as 1.2 GB

downloadAfterInstall.value: Yes. One click (Download OpenFrame AI) fetches the files from public Hugging Face repositories at pinned commits; each file is checked against size and SHA-256 compiled into the app; resumable; model files can also be imported by hand. The runtime (llama.cpp b11259) ships inside the app.

offline.value: After the one-time download the AI runs fully on the computer; inference only to 127.0.0.1 with a per-launch key; no cloud AI, no API keys, no accounts.

engines.value: Windows: llama.cpp CPU and Vulkan builds (x64). Mac: llama.cpp Metal build as a helper process. Apple on-device model is decided as opt-in but not built.

whatItDoes.value: Answers questions about the open project with sources behind 'See sources'; proposes changes (scenes, cards, characters, catalog items, notes, tasks, schedule, shots, moodboards and more) as one Proposed Changes set per request that a person reads and applies or rejects; crash-safe apply; undoable.

whatItNeverDoes.value: Never changes a project without the person's Apply; never sends project data off the computer; never reads other people's private notes or the Story page; refuses licence, payment and team-password requests; the person never picks a model by name; no model judges answers at run time.

measuredQuality.value: English, development laptop (proof level 2): 96.7 percent correct tool, 88.8 percent correct end state (bar 90 and 85). Mac Apple silicon: 96.7 and 88.6. Prompt-injection set 60 of 60 safe. Other languages measured but well below English.

languages.value: English held to the release bar; Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese and Korean supported and measured, reviewed by Claude only (no native speaker yet). AI answers in the language of the request.

dataStorage.value: Each project is a folder <Title>.openframe containing openframe.json (manifest), project.sqlite (SQLite), assets/, cache/, recovery/, backups/ and a .lock file. Default location Documents\OpenFrame\Projects on Windows and ~/Documents/OpenFrame on the Mac; app settings in %LOCALAPPDATA%\OpenFrame\app.sqlite or ~/Library/Application Support/OpenFrame. Global Idea Vault in Documents\OpenFrame\Global Idea Vault. Network (UNC) paths are refused; cloud-synced folders get a warning.

networkAndTelemetry.value: No telemetry, analytics, crash upload or update check. No account or sign-in. No network listener reachable from other computers. Network is used only for (1) the AI model download the person starts (huggingface.co and its CDN only), (2) opening a saved Idea Vault link in the default browser, (3) the Windows installer fetching Microsoft's WebView2 bootstrapper if missing. WebView2 background networking is switched off. Diagnostics bundle is user-started only; local logs kept 14 days.

importFormats.ideaVaultFiles: Notes, images, links, any file, voice notes (recorded in the app), video

dailyView: TXT (Windows core; Mac core reported PDF, CSV, XLSX)
exportFormats.branding: Screenplay files carry no OpenFrame branding; production PDFs carry a small 'Created using OpenFrame' line; CSV is clean.

writingLanguages.value: Any Unicode text can be typed, saved, searched and exported to FDX, Fountain and DOCX. Screenplay PDF embeds and shapes Latin (Courier Prime), Devanagari, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada and Malayalam; other scripts (for example Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic) are refused by PDF export with a clear message. Production PDFs use base-14 Latin fonts. Spell check uses dictionaries installed in the operating system, with a main and a second language. App screens are English only.

themes.modes: Light, Dark, System; custom themes can be imported, pasted, renamed, exported

pricing.note: Targets only. An earlier owner message said 2,999 rupees. Price, refunds and what the trial unlocks are open (Chapter 3). The app never shows a price; the store's purchase window does.

trial.value: 7-day free trial, no credit card to start, then paid activation; through the Microsoft Store and the Mac App Store only
trial.note: Trial code exists and is tested only with fakes. Internal builds have no trial, price, purchase or lock. After the trial ends without purchase the store builds block the app except Buy and Restore.

storePlans.value: Microsoft Store (MSIX, Store-run trial) and Mac App Store (zero-price 7-day Trial and paid Lifetime Access non-consumables), with signing and notarization, in Chapter 3. Partner Center and Apple Developer accounts not yet created; legal entity not registered.

companyLegalContact.known: Not decided. Publisher, legal entity, privacy contact, support e-mail, domain and company e-mail are all owner tasks for Chapters 2 and 3. Tauri config publisher is a placeholder 'OpenFrame Studio contributors'. Website hosting proposed on Cloudflare Pages. EULA not written (LICENSE-PENDING). The product is paid and closed source.

collaboration.value: No live or network collaboration (removed, ADR-0007). File-based only: Screenplay review packages and Beat Board packages are exported and sent by any means; recipients reply with a response package; the sender sees it in the Review Queue and previews changes before applying. Comments panel on the screenplay. Backups and full-project packages move a project between computers. No accounts and no roles in the interface (the core has a permission model used by packages). A single-writer lock stops two apps writing one project at once.

screenEvidence.warning: WindowsHTML screens 416 to 433 (licence, trial, Buy) come from a simulated store state; they are not live in any build.

claimsRule.value: Nothing is advertised unless Verified on the exact build people download at proof level 3 or higher; the same applies to screenshots and HTML recreations. Highest proof today is level 3 on the developer's laptop; nothing at level 4 (clean machine) or 5 (people).
